Class TurSolrPropertySource

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.solr.source.TurSolrPropertySource
All Implemented Interfaces:
TurSolrInstanceSource
public class TurSolrPropertySource extends Object implements TurSolrInstanceSource
Property-backed implementation of TurSolrInstanceSource. Exposes a single synthetic TurSEInstance built from turing.solr.endpoint. Mutations throw UnsupportedOperationException — the SE instance catalog is read-only in this mode.
Since:
2026.2.4
Author:
Alexandre Oliveira
